canonical_term: Douglas, Lancaster, and Sarpy Real Property Tax Delinquency Dates
summary: In Douglas, Lancaster, and Sarpy counties, first-half real property taxes become delinquent April 1 and second-half taxes become delinquent August 1.
plain_language: The three largest counties have earlier delinquency dates: April 1 and August 1.

dates.description: First half delinquent in Douglas, Lancaster, and Sarpy counties.
Second half delinquent in Douglas, Lancaster, and Sarpy counties.
